property_summary: For any sendMoney call by the owner, depositsCount is unchanged and the total Ether held by the owner-controlled accounts (test contract plus C) is conserved regardless of whether the call reverts or succeeds, because any value sent goes to the target which is the test contract itself in this setup.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `sendMoney(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
